design_goals: Preserve the frozen aes_sbox interface exactly.
Implement pure combinational substitution with no sequential state.
Produce CHK_SBOX_MATCH through the self-checking .cpp testbench.
implementation_hints: Start from the frozen interface and keep these ports stable: in_byte, out_byte.
Use the declared vectors and required checkpoints as the first acceptance targets: CHK_SBOX_MATCH.
Emit checkpoints using the exact frozen contract CHECKPOINT|CHK_SBOX_MATCH|PASS|<detail>.
Verify draft RTL and draft TB produce correct results before the second validation pass.
Use a combinational lookup or case statement that satisfies these frozen KAT mappings first: 8'h00 -> 8'h63, 8'h53 -> 8'hed, 8'h7c -> 8'h10, 8'hff -> 8'h16.
repair_hints: Read generation_result.json, workspace_state.json, and validation_summary.json before editing after a failed validation run.
Fix the first missing or failed checkpoint before broader refactors.
When editing a .cpp testbench, emit the exact CHECKPOINT contract CHECKPOINT|CHK_SBOX_MATCH|PASS|<detail> rather than a bare checkpoint name.
After a failed executor run, make at least one concrete draft RTL or TB edit before rerunning the executor command.
Use a combinational lookup or case statement that satisfies these frozen KAT mappings first: 8'h00 -> 8'h63, 8'h53 -> 8'hed, 8'h7c -> 8'h10, 8'hff -> 8'h16.
summary: Generate aes_sbox for the AES-128 encrypt autonomous full-system.
workspace_strategy: Generate and edit only draft files under the session workspace. Promote to canonical RTL/TB only after L0 and L1 pass.
